output.summary: A herbaceous perennial native to the British Isles, much of the Mediterranean region, the Caucasus, Canary Islands, Madeira and northern Africa. Its white spring flowers give way to showy red fruit, and its flower structure produces heat. In Croatia, corms were eaten during famines, though the leaves, fruits and rhizomes are poisonous and tuber ingestion may be fatal.
